title: Three Dirty Dwarves
overview:
Smash your enemies, smash your friends - that's the life of a dirty dwarf.

Play Dirty!

- 15 levels of non-stop, bash-everything action.
- Rotate between dwarves on the fly for multiple attacks.
- Utilize special weapons of each dwarf - Greg, Taconic and Corthag.
- Crush evil orc armies and host of other big city nasties on way to final battle at WST (Weapons System Technologies).
- Up to 3 players
- Three levels of difficulty for Dwarves of all sizes.

Heroes have never been this dirty.
